Attached: 1 image

Checkmate v3.11.0 brings a major update to the open-source monitoring tool.

The standout feature is domain expiry tracking, ensuring you never lose a domain. It also adds selectable time ranges on status pages, Rocket.Chat notifications, and outbound proxy support.

Update available soon on PikaPods!

Release: https://github.com/bluewave-labs/Checkmate/releases/tag/v3.11.0
Run: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=checkmate

#opensource #selfhosted
